_doc: Substantive adversarial review requires independent Terra high and HY3 high passes; deterministic checks remain separate.

tier_policy._doc: naia-agent 원조 2계층의 하네스 정규화. 머리쓰기·설계·실질검증=상위(플래그십) / 형식검증=하위(라이트) / 구조=결정론(LLM 무).

degradation._doc: Both required substantive reviewers must pass. A timeout or failure of either reviewer does not substitute another LLM; rerun that reviewer after resolving the execution problem.
degradation.on_timeout: do not substitute another LLM; rerun Terra

excluded.gemini-cli: 응답 5분+ 불안정 (2026-05-30 실측). 검증층은 timeout+graceful degradation 필요. 속도·신뢰 필요 시 Vertex 등 유료 API 옵션.
